name: JAZ-X Social Autopilot
author: jazxinnovation

sections.description:
JAZ-X Social Autopilot connects an authorized Facebook Page once and shares newly published WordPress articles automatically. The Free service currently permits up to two shares per UTC day per paired website. WordPress articles continue to publish normally after the daily sharing allowance is reached.

This plugin requires a connection to the external JAZ-X Social Connector service at https://connect.jazx.online for Facebook OAuth, Page token storage, API publishing, and sharing quotas. The connector exchanges data necessary to pair the site and publish approved new post URLs, including the site origin and a site-scoped credential. By connecting Facebook, the site administrator authorizes the plugin to share posts to their selected Facebook Page. Meta’s own permissions and limits also apply.

The optional JAZ-X Social Autopilot Pro add-on requires the Free plugin and a separately licensed service entitlement. This Free plugin does not include the Pro license or license manager.

External services

This plugin requires the JAZ-X Social Connector, a service operated by JAZ-X Innovation at https://connect.jazx.online, and the Facebook platform operated by Meta. The plugin cannot connect or publish to Facebook without these services. Connecting a Page is an explicit action by a WordPress administrator; no Facebook Page is connected merely by installing the plugin.

JAZ-X Social Connector

Purpose: Verify ownership of the WordPress site, manage Facebook authorization, securely store Page access tokens, provide connected Page information, enforce the Free sharing allowance, and submit approved posts for publishing.

Data sent and timing:
* When the administrator initiates site pairing, the site URL (origin), randomly generated site/tenant identifier, and site-scoped authentication credential are sent to https://connect.jazx.online. The connector verifies site ownership using a challenge to the WordPress site’s REST API.
* When an administrator initiates Facebook connection, authorization is completed using the connector and Facebook. The connector processes Facebook account identification, authorized Page IDs, Page names, and Page access tokens necessary for the selected Page connection. Access tokens are stored encrypted on the connector, not shown in the WordPress dashboard.
* When the administrator views connection or quota information, the site identifier, site URL and authentication credential accompany requests to the connector, which returns Page or sharing status information.
* When a newly published WordPress post is eligible for auto-sharing, the site identifier, site URL, authentication credential, selected Facebook Page ID, the public article URL and a deduplication identifier are sent to the connector. No unpublished article body is sent. The service then passes the public URL and Page authorization data to Meta for publication.
* When the administrator explicitly disconnects a Page, the connector is sent the selected Page ID and authenticated site identity to remove that connection.

Service provider: JAZ-X Innovation (JAZ-X Social Connector).
Privacy policy: https://store.jazx.online/privacy-policy/
Terms of service: https://store.jazx.online/terms-conditions/

Facebook / Meta

Purpose: Allow an administrator to authorize a Facebook Page and publish links to newly published WordPress posts on that Page through the Meta Graph API.

Data sent and timing: During administrator-initiated Facebook OAuth, Meta processes the authorization request and account permissions. When sharing is enabled and a new WordPress post is published, the connector sends the selected Page identifier, its authorized Page access token, and the public post URL to the Meta Graph API. Meta can process post previews using publicly available website metadata. The connector may also query the authorized Page list during connection.

Service provider: Meta Platforms, Inc.
Privacy policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
Terms of service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate JAZ-X Social Autopilot.
  2. Open the plugin dashboard and connect your Facebook Page.
  3. New WordPress posts can then auto-share without an additional toggle.
sections.faq:
Will my WordPress posts stop publishing after two Facebook shares?

No. Only automatic Facebook sharing is limited; WordPress publishing continues.

Is this plugin affiliated with Facebook?

No. Facebook is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Load admin styles using the WordPress stylesheet enqueue API.
  • Document external connector and Meta data transfers with privacy and terms links.

0.5.14

  • Fix Plugin Check readme header and plugin-name alignment.
  • Add the translation directory referenced by the plugin header.

0.5.13

  • Declare GPL-compatible license and add readme.txt.
  • Align translation text domain with the existing staging plugin directory.
  • Restrict external authorization redirects via wp_safe_redirect and a tightly scoped host allowlist.
  • Clarify nonce handling and sanitize administrative form inputs.
  • Preserve existing social connector integration, post sharing, and Pro add-on bridge.
